contract: Every holiday carries a fact somebody softened. I post the real one before the day arrives.

beats.html:
Victorians were frightened
enough of being buried alive
to patent a way out.

Safety coffins came with
bells, ropes
and breathing tubes.

A whole industry grew
around a fear nobody
would say out loud.

Fear does not stay quiet.
It builds things.
